title: Foundations: pool, retrieval, seed guide
prose: Phase 0-1. Source the gating inputs (licensed RF2 snapshot; a bilingual exemplar pool — the single biggest quality determinant; a committed SME; a domain slice of ~5k concepts). Curate the pool declaratively (drop non-clinical rows, rewrite export artifacts — the raw pool is never edited; each curated version gets its own retrieval index, and embedding vectors are reused across versions). Seed the style guide minimally: script, spacing, formatting. Do not guess editorial policy — the SME rounds will write it.
